hypotheses.title: allowlist-lookup
hypotheses.rationale: count_by_kind in tagfilter/core.py tests every tag against the allowlist by scanning the list from its start. Build a lookup with constant-time membership from the allowlist once per call and test the tags against it; the output must not change.

hypotheses.title: init-kinds-once
hypotheses.rationale: count_by_kind calls dict.setdefault for every record. Collect the kinds first and initialise each counter once, so the loop only increments.

hypotheses.title: build-matcher-once
hypotheses.rationale: mentions in keywordscan/core.py builds and compiles the pattern of the whole watch list again for every log line. Build the matcher once per hits_by_level call and reuse it for every line; whole-word matching and the counts must not change.

hypotheses.title: lowercase-lines
hypotheses.rationale: Lower-case each log line before searching it, so the regular expression engine compares a smaller alphabet.

hypotheses.title: collect-then-join
hypotheses.rationale: Report in reportbuild/core.py appends every row to one growing string attribute, which copies the whole report on each row. Collect the pieces and join them once when the text is read; the report must stay byte-for-byte identical.

hypotheses.title: pad-regions-once
hypotheses.rationale: render pads every region name with ljust per row; build a table of padded region names once instead.

hypotheses.title: range-outside-loop
hypotheses.rationale: rescale in scorenorm/core.py recomputes the minimum and the maximum of the whole list for every value. Compute them once before the loop; the scaled values must be the identical floats.

hypotheses.title: summary-one-pass
hypotheses.rationale: summary walks the scaled list twice, for the sum and for the share above 0.9. Compute both in a single pass.

hypotheses.title: track-the-leader
hypotheses.rationale: replay in leaderboard/core.py sorts the whole board again after every result only to read its first entry. Track the best entry as results arrive and sort once at the end for the top three; the leaders and the top three must not change.

hypotheses.title: presize-lists
hypotheses.rationale: replay grows its two lists with append; preallocate them to the number of results to avoid resizing.

hypotheses.title: customers-by-id
hypotheses.rationale: totals_by_region in orderlookup/core.py finds each order's customer by scanning the customer list. Map the customers by id once per call (the first customer wins for a repeated id) and look every order up in it; an unknown customer must still raise KeyError and the output must not change.

hypotheses.title: fixed-region-order
hypotheses.rationale: totals_by_region sorts the totals at the end; emit the regions in a fixed order instead of sorting.

hypotheses.title: audit-without-copy
hypotheses.rationale: simulate in inventorysim/core.py takes a full deep copy of the warehouse every day only to read its stock value before the day runs. Read the value from the warehouse itself before the day is applied; the audit and the final state must not change.

hypotheses.title: non-strict-zip
hypotheses.rationale: stock_value zips stock and price with strict=True; drop the strictness check to save the length comparison.

hypotheses.title: classify-before-int
hypotheses.rationale: tally in tokenparse/core.py converts every token with int() and treats the raised ValueError as a word, and most tokens are words. Decide whether a token is an optionally negative run of ASCII digits before converting it, so no exception is raised for a word; the counts and the sum must not change.

hypotheses.title: split-on-space
hypotheses.rationale: tally splits the text with str.split(); split on a single space instead, since the stream uses single spaces.

hypotheses.title: count-in-one-pass
hypotheses.rationale: frequencies in wordcount/core.py scans the whole word list once per distinct word. Count every word in a single pass and order the result by word once; the frequencies and their order must not change.

hypotheses.title: itemgetter-key
hypotheses.rationale: most_common sorts with a lambda key; build the sort key without a lambda.

hypotheses.title: parse-rules-once
hypotheses.rationale: rule_for in configlookup/core.py parses the whole JSON rule set for every line item. Parse it once and reuse it, without letting a caller's change to a returned rule leak into later lookups; the prices must not change.

hypotheses.title: group-per-category
hypotheses.rationale: totals slices the category name for every item; precompute the group of each category.

hypotheses.title: remember-subcounts
hypotheses.rationale: ways in stairways/core.py recomputes the counts of the same smaller heights an exponential number of times. Remember each height's count (or build the counts bottom-up) so each height is computed once; the counts must not change.

hypotheses.title: reorder-base-cases
hypotheses.rationale: Test height == 0 before height < 0 in ways, since zero is reached more often.

hypotheses.title: front-removal-queue
hypotheses.rationale: hops in graphwalk/core.py removes the next member from the front of a list, which shifts every pending member each time. Use a queue whose front removal takes constant time (or walk the list with a read position); the distances must not change.

hypotheses.title: targets-as-tuples
hypotheses.rationale: Store each member's targets as a tuple instead of a list in graphwalk/data.py, for faster iteration.

hypotheses.title: one-update-per-block
hypotheses.rationale: image_digest in blockhash/core.py calls update twice per block; feed each block and its number to the hash in one update call.

hypotheses.title: bigger-chunks
hypotheses.rationale: Join several blocks before each update so the hash is fed larger chunks.

hypotheses.title: sort-the-array
hypotheses.rationale: sample in sortstats/core.py converts the array of readings to a list; sort the readings without converting them.

hypotheses.title: reuse-array-bytes
hypotheses.rationale: checksum builds a new array from the sorted list; reuse the bytes of the array the sample was read into.

hypotheses.title: plain-dict-count
hypotheses.rationale: top_words in lettertally/core.py counts with collections.Counter; count with a plain dict and sort by count instead.

hypotheses.title: getrandbits-sampling
hypotheses.rationale: sample draws words with random.choices; draw the indices with getrandbits instead.

hypotheses.title: rank-by-sorting
hypotheses.rationale: ranks in gradebook/core.py counts, for every student, how many students have a higher mean by scanning all means. Sort the means once and derive each competition rank from the sorted order (equal means share a rank); the ranks must not change.

hypotheses.title: fmean-averages
hypotheses.rationale: averages divides sum() by len(); use statistics.fmean instead.

hypotheses.title: heap-frontier
hypotheses.rationale: cheapest in routeplan/core.py picks the next stop by scanning the whole frontier and removes it from the list. Keep the frontier in a priority queue ordered by (cost, stop) and skip stale entries; the costs must not change.

hypotheses.title: roads-as-tuples
hypotheses.rationale: network builds each stop's roads as a list; build tuples instead.

hypotheses.title: seen-lookup
hypotheses.rationale: duplicates in invoicer/core.py checks every invoice number against the list of numbers seen so far. Keep the seen numbers in a structure with constant-time membership; the repeated numbers and their order must not change.

hypotheses.title: numbers-only
hypotheses.rationale: duplicates unpacks every (number, cents) pair; iterate over the numbers only.
